text:
elaine: Heads-up — BrightLoom reporting a flurry of 504s starting ~22:10 UTC. Customer says calls time out intermittently, p95 spiking. Gateway logs show "request_queue_rejected: queue_depth=1024" repeatedly. Looks like a sustained tail backlog on continuous-batcher. :worried:

miguel: Thanks @elaine — can you paste the gateway logs and sample request that reproduces? Any sign of huge sequence lengths or streaming bodies?

elaine: Copying a trimmed snippet from the gateway:```[2026-03-17T22:11:04Z] WARN gateway request_queue_rejected tenant=brightloom queue_depth=1024 limit=1024 duration_ms=12k cause=batcher_backlog
[2026-03-17T22:11:05Z] ERROR runtime request_timeout tenant=brightloom route=/v1/generate status=504 msg=dequeue_timeout kv_cache_miss=1 seq_len=32768
[2026-03-17T22:11:06Z] WARN batcher backlog_size=312 pending_shards=6 kvcache_spin=true
```
Sample user payload (redacted) is a streamed prompt with ~30k tokens and function calls enabled. They ramped up a large import job around 22:05 which correlates.

thomas: Sounds like KV cache warmup + longseqs + continuous-batching = batcher overload. Two quick mitigations: 1) short-term: enable tenant fallback to a smaller model variant or disable long streaming for that tenant; 2) temporarily increase request queue depth for the affected gateway pool while we triage.

jess: I can repro locally with a simulated 32k token request. Repro curl:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted.example/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rw-long-1.0","input":"<32k tokens padded>"}'
```
Expect: repeated 502/504 when queue fills, logs show batcher_spin and kvcache cold misses.

miguel: I'm attaching a temporary debug flag to the gateway to emit per-tenant queue metrics and batcher tracing. Also toggling kvcache prefetch for brightloom to reduce misses. Pushing now — will report if we see errors drop. :construction:

support-bot: incident created INC-20260317-8472 for tenant brightloom — severity 2, assigned to platform-oncall.

platform-oncall: Oncall here, I'm going to: 1) patch gateway to raise soft queue limit to 1500 for the affected pool, 2) enable model fallback policy for brightloom to rw-short-1.1, 3) coordinate with infra to add a temporary dedicated slot if traffic continues. Applying step 1 now.

elaine: After raising soft limit we saw a brief reduction in rejects but p95 still high. Observed continuous-batcher backlog drop from 312 -> 90 over ~3min, then a second spike when another batch of importing jobs started.

miguel: Added a rate-limit rule to throttle the import job at the customer gateway (30rps burst cap). That immediately reduced inflight longseq requests. Monitoring.

thomas: For follow-ups: we should add a tenant-specific policy that auto-converts very long streaming requests to chunked uploads + async job if above X tokens, and add an alert for kvcache_spin_ratio > 0.2. I'll open a backlog ticket for policy change.

jess: Confirmed support-side: BrightLoom accepted enabling the fallback model for now. They reported success for ~20 min with no 504s. We'll keep monitoring for 1 hour then reassess. :thumbsup:

platform-oncall: Updated incident INC-20260317-8472: mitigations applied (queue soft-limit up, tenant fallback enabled, customer import throttled). Marking as "mitigated" pending follow-up KTs and a runbook update.

elaine: Adding notes for postmortem: root cause = tenant ramp of long-context streaming jobs -> KV cache cold spikiness -> continuous-batcher backlog -> queue depth hits limit -> early reject/timeouts. Action items: 1) tenant auto-fallback policy, 2) kvcache prefetch heuristics for large longseqs, 3) per-tenant burst detection alert, 4) docs for sales about dedicated capacity recommendation for heavy long-context workloads.

miguel: Logging follow-up ticket: RWD-INF-2039 (kvcache prefetch heuristics) and RWD-OPS-1402 (tenant auto-fallback policy).

elaine: Thanks all. Closing thread, will add PM+SRE for postmortem next week. :white_check_mark:
